story.title: The Vulcodile's Volcano Escape
story.signature_move: It uses its crocodile-like low body to slide unseen over hot ash, then flicks its white-tipped fox tail to distract the salamander.
story.hybrid_look: A long, low, armoured body with a fox-shaped head, crocodile eyes, slim black-socked legs, and a huge white-tipped brush of a tail, moving with a silent, sly step across tough rows of bony scutes mixed with fur.

sentences.text: It only stalks those who steal from the volcano.
sentences.image: jagged obsidian slopes glowing with bright orange rivers of liquid fire under dark ash clouds
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: Meet the Vulcodile, an imaginary beast blending a fox with a heavy crocodile.
sentences.image: vast fields of grey pumice stone hissing with white sulfur steam vents under a purple twilight
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: Sliding low through hot cinders, it uses its fox tail to trick the salamander.
sentences.image: crumbling ledges of black basalt overlooking a boiling crater filled with bubbling red magma
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: Suddenly, a roaring magma-hound ten times its size breaks from the smoke.
sentences.image: massive walls of ancient volcanic rock cracking open as waves of intense heat ripple the air
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: I watched it flatten its armoured spine into the gray dust to hide.
sentences.image: steep ridges of hardened lava dust glowing faintly beneath showers of falling fiery sparks
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: When that ambush fails, it relies on the clever cunning of a fox.
sentences.image: deep fissures in the earth venting roaring columns of yellow flame into the night sky
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: It dashes sideways into a tight steam vent, leaving the giant behind.
sentences.image: narrow canyons of sharp red rock choked with thick white steam and swirling ash
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: Yet it instantly freezes if someone drops a stolen pebble, and what should I combine next? Tell me in the comments.
sentences.image: silent valleys of dark volcanic sand resting quietly beneath a canopy of distant stars
sentences.speaker: narrator
